definitions.meaning: A man's measure, stature of a man

source_text: wer-met, es; n. A man's measure, stature of a man:--Tó wermete ad staturam, Wrt. Voc. ii. 72, 23: 8, 70. (In both cases stauram is printed; but the former is a gloss on Mt. 6, 27. v. Wülck. Gl. 479, 23.)
